# Patent

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Patent`](gmeow-Patent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Patent>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An abstract intellectual work describing an invention — the inventive concept as claimed, independent of any granted or filed document. A specialization of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Patent`](gmeow-Patent.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the abstract inventive concept as claimed — the patented invention at the [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md) tier, independent of any filing or grant document.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the granted or filed paper artifact itself (model that as a [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md)) and avoid encoding inventor agency as a literal — route it through the contribution relator.

### How to use

- Type the invention [`gmeow:Patent`](gmeow-Patent.md), carry the patent number on [`gmeow:identifier`](../properties/gmeow-identifier.md) and the grant/filing dates on the bibliographic date properties; link the granted document as a separate [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md).

### Examples

- ex:patent a [`gmeow:Patent`](gmeow-Patent.md); [`gmeow:identifier`](../properties/gmeow-identifier.md) "US10000000B2"; [`gmeow:datePublished`](../properties/gmeow-datePublished.md) "2018-06-19T00:00:00Z"^^[xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)
